title: Give Back & Give Out
situation: Returning borrowed items and distributing supplies.
objective: Use give back and give out to talk about returning and sharing things.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: After the check, I give back the test tools to the storage room.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah pemeriksaan, saya mengembalikan alat uji ke ruang penyimpanan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Please give back the radio before the end of the shift.
dialogue.indonesian: Tolong kembalikan radio sebelum akhir shift.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: In the morning, we give out new gloves to the team.
dialogue.indonesian: Pada pagi hari, kami membagikan sarung tangan baru kepada tim.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I give out the small parts from the delivery box.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya membagikan suku cadang kecil dari kotak pengiriman.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: We give back what we borrow and give out what the team needs.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami mengembalikan apa yang kami pinjam dan membagikan apa yang dibutuhkan tim.

learningNotes: give back berarti mengembalikan sesuatu, dan give out berarti membagikan sesuatu.
Pronoun diletakkan di tengah: give it back, give them out.
give out juga bisa berarti habis, tetapi di sini artinya membagikan.
